workflows.name: debug-startup
workflows.title: Startup Debug Sweep
workflows.description: Launch the desktop shell in fixture mode and walk the highest-signal startup and diagnostics pages for quick issue triage.

steps.title: Strategy Workspace
steps.notes: Confirm that the shell rendered, the demo data banner is visible, and the status bar started updating.

steps.title: Provider Health
steps.notes: Check provider-level status badges, connection health, and any immediately visible fault indicators.

steps.title: Diagnostics
steps.notes: Use the diagnostics surface to inspect errors, remediation affordances, and high-level health signals.

steps.title: Advance Fixture Scenario
steps.notes: Cycle fixture mode once so degraded-state visuals can be checked without touching production services.

steps.title: System Health
steps.notes: Verify that health cards and status chips react to a non-happy-path fixture scenario.

steps.title: Settings
steps.notes: Finish in Settings so configuration-related startup issues can be inspected quickly.

workflows.name: manual-overview
workflows.title: Platform Overview
workflows.description: A top-level walkthrough of the shell, workspace launcher, and the four major workstation shells.

steps.title: Strategy Workspace
steps.notes: Start on the Strategy workspace to review the shell status bar, demo data banner, and the first-launch landing experience.

steps.title: Workspace Layouts
steps.notes: Use Workspace layouts to inspect saved layouts and workstation surface organization.

steps.title: Strategy Workspace
steps.notes: The Strategy workspace now keeps the current workspace next action above the fold while secondary workspace actions stay behind expansion.

steps.title: Trading Workspace
steps.notes: The Trading workspace now leads with active positions, workflow blocker/next action, and risk posture before KPI tiles and supporting desk lanes.

steps.title: Data Workspace
steps.notes: The Data workspace centralizes providers, backfills, symbols, and storage operations.

steps.title: Accounting Workspace
steps.notes: The Accounting workspace now exposes an explicit workbench identity so overview, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting modes stay obvious at a glance.

steps.title: Help
steps.notes: The Help page is the starting point when an operator needs setup guidance or troubleshooting references.

workflows.name: manual-data
workflows.title: Data Workflow
workflows.description: A practical walkthrough for operators who manage providers, symbols, storage, and backfills.

steps.title: Data Workspace
steps.notes: Begin in the workspace shell to orient around the operator dashboard and the available data tools.

steps.title: Providers
steps.notes: Manage active providers, credentials, and connectivity from the Providers screen.

steps.title: Provider Health
steps.notes: Review feed health, current statuses, and degraded-state signals before changing collection behavior.

steps.title: Backfill
steps.notes: Use Backfill to queue or inspect historical data collection work.

steps.title: Data Sources
steps.notes: Use Data Sources to review provider routing, failover ordering, and feed configuration without leaving the Data workflow.

steps.title: Storage
steps.notes: Use Storage to inspect retention, layout, and data organization settings.

steps.title: Data Quality
steps.notes: Finish with Data Quality so anomalies and remediation work can be reviewed in one pass.

workflows.name: manual-strategy-and-trading
workflows.title: Strategy and Trading Workflow
workflows.description: Walk through the core strategy surfaces and the trading cockpit used to inspect positions and risk.

steps.title: Strategy Workspace
steps.notes: The Strategy workspace is the umbrella view for strategy discovery, analysis, and run review.

steps.title: Backtest
steps.notes: Use Backtest to configure a strategy replay and inspect summary metrics.

steps.title: Strategy Runs
steps.notes: Use Strategy Runs to browse completed runs and drill into the detail pages.

steps.title: Quant Script
steps.notes: Use Quant Script for exploratory scripting and ad hoc analysis.

steps.title: Trading Workspace
steps.notes: Switch to the Trading workspace to capture the action-first cockpit layout, with positions, current blocker, and primary desk action ahead of supporting narrative lanes.

steps.title: Position Blotter
steps.notes: Use the Position Blotter to capture the grid-first layout, batch-action readiness, and the simplified single-path blocked state.

steps.title: Run Risk
steps.notes: Finish on Run Risk to validate the controls and risk views that govern a strategy run.

workflows.name: manual-accounting
workflows.title: Accounting Workflow
workflows.description: Cover the oversight surfaces used for accounting, reconciliation, reporting, and reference-data governance.

steps.title: Accounting Workspace
steps.notes: Start in Accounting to orient around the oversight shell and confirm the shared workbench identity card.

steps.title: Fund Ledger
steps.notes: Use Fund Ledger to capture the single Accounting workbench with explicit mode/workbench identity above the tabs.

steps.title: Fund Reconciliation
steps.notes: Use Fund Reconciliation to capture the deep-link route banner plus the prominent ownership and stale-snapshot posture.

steps.title: Fund Report Pack
steps.notes: Use Fund Report Pack to capture the reporting-mode route banner, handoff readiness, sign-off owner, and freshness warning.

steps.title: Security Master
steps.notes: Use Security Master to review reference data coverage and investigate security-level issues.

steps.title: Settings
steps.notes: Finish in Settings to capture the explicit shell-density preference that now controls shell verbosity independently from window mode.
